info.title: TredMail API
info.description: Transactional email API by Dovepeak Technologies. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer tred_live_...`. Request and response bodies are JSON with snake_case fields. Errors share one shape: `{ statusCode, error, message }`.

tags.name: Emails
tags.description: Send, schedule, cancel and inspect emails.

tags.name: Domains
tags.description: Sending domains and their DNS records.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Event notifications to your endpoints, signed with Standard Webhooks.

tags.name: Suppressions
tags.description: Addresses TredMail will not send to.

post.description:
Queues one email. Give `html`, `text` or both, or a `template` with `variables`. With `scheduled_at` the email waits until that time (up to 30 days).

Requires the `emails:send` scope.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes the request safe to retry: the same key and body within 24 hours return the original response (with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) instead of sending again.

schema.description: One or more statuses, comma separated, e.g. `bounced,failed`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search subject, sender, recipient or email id.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Created at or after this time.

post.description:
Each email is accepted or rejected independently; the response lists results in request order. Also available at `POST /batch`.

Requires the `emails:send` scope.

get.description:
The email with its full event timeline.

Requires the `emails:read` scope.

patch.description:
Moves a scheduled email to a new time. A time in the past sends it now.

Requires the `emails:send` scope.

post.description:
Renders the template with sample variables without sending anything.

Requires the `templates:manage` scope.

Creates the domain with a fresh 2048-bit DKIM key and returns the DNS records to publish.

Requires the `domains:manage` scope.

get.description:
Includes each DNS record with whether it was found at the last verification.

Requires the `domains:read` scope.

delete.description:
Refused while emails from the domain are still waiting to be sent.

Requires the `domains:manage` scope.

post.description:
Looks up DKIM, SPF, DMARC and the return path in public DNS and updates the domain's status.

Requires the `domains:manage` scope.

get.description:
Totals from the DMARC aggregate reports mailbox providers sent for this domain (its `rua=` must point at TredMail).

Requires the `domains:read` scope.

post.description:
The response contains the signing `secret`, shown only once.

Requires the `webhooks:manage` scope.

patch.description:
Change the URL or events, or pause (`is_active: false`) and resume.

Requires the `webhooks:manage` scope.

post.description:
Delivers one `email.delivered` test event right away (no retries) and reports the result.

Requires the `webhooks:manage` scope.

Issues a new secret, shown once. Deliveries are signed with it immediately.

Requires the `webhooks:manage` scope.

get.description:
Every event sent to the endpoint, with attempts and the last response. Failed deliveries are retried for about 27 hours.

Requires the `webhooks:manage` scope.

post.description:
Sends the same event again with the same `webhook-id`, so receivers can drop duplicates.

Requires the `webhooks:manage` scope.

Replays every failed delivery of the last 7 days, for example after an outage on your side.

Requires the `webhooks:manage` scope.

delete.description:
Allows sending to the address again. Only do this when you know the address is valid again.

Requires the `suppressions:manage` scope.

post.description:
The `token` is returned once. A key cannot grant scopes it does not hold.

Requires the `api_keys:manage` scope.

get.description:
Emails per UTC day reaching each outcome. Opens and clicks count unique emails.

Requires the `stats:read` scope.

apiKey.description: An API key from Console → API keys.

Error400.description: The request is malformed or fails validation.

Error403.description: The key lacks the required scope, or the sender is not allowed.

Error409.description: Conflicts with the current state (e.g. canceling an email that is already sending).

Error422.description: Understood but cannot be processed (e.g. suppressed recipient, unverified domain).

Error429.description: Rate limit or sandbox limit reached. Retry later.

from.description: Sender on a verified domain, e.g. `Dovepeak <billing@dovepeakdigital.com>`. Optional when the template has one.

template.description: Template id or alias. Request fields override the template's.

scheduled_at.description: Send at this time (up to 30 days ahead). Omit to send now.

headers.description: Custom headers. Standard and `X-TredMail-*` headers are reserved.

tags.description: Up to 50. A `category` tag groups Gmail Postmaster statistics.

attachments.description: Up to 20; total request size 10 MB.

html.description: Erased after the retention period (30 days by default).

details.description: Recipient, server response, bounce category and similar.

alias.description: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Used as `template` when sending.

html.description: {{name}} is HTML-escaped; {{{name}}} inserts raw HTML; {{name|fallback}} sets a default.

variables.description: Variables used in the subject and bodies.

host.description: Name relative to the domain, as DNS panels ask for it (`@` for the domain itself)

verified.description: Found at the last verification (GET /domains/{id} only)

response.description: First 1,000 characters of your endpoint's response

post.description: Sent to your endpoint for each subscribed event. Verify the `webhook-signature` header: base64 HMAC-SHA256 of `{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{body}` keyed with the base64 part of your `whsec_` secret, prefixed `v1,`. Reject timestamps older than 5 minutes. Respond 2xx within 10 seconds; other responses are retried for about 27 hours.
